title: Inertia and mass
text:
Read and explain

Target R6

Inertia and mass

**Inertia** is resistance to a change in velocity. Mass measures this for motion from place to place.

With the same net force, more mass means a slower change in velocity.

Inertia belongs to the object. Do not add an extra force arrow for it.
